task.description:
Author 3 UAT scenarios for Meridian Capital AG.

Read the process definitions in tests/simulation/companies/meridian/:
- process_loan_origination.yaml
- process_regulatory_compliance_review.yaml

Read docs/agents/uat-scenario-schema.md for the required YAML format.
Read tests/simulation/companies/meridian/org_structure.yaml for actor IDs.

SCENARIO 1 — meridian-loan-origination-above-threshold.yaml
Title: "Large loan (€750k) routed through full credit committee"
A loan application for €750,000 (above €500k threshold) is submitted.
L1 credit officer (Julia Hartmann, actor-meridian-julia) assesses.
L2 credit director reviews.
Since amount >€500k, credit committee vote is triggered with quorum 2-of-3.
Loan is approved and disbursed.
via: api steps.

SCENARIO 2 — meridian-loan-origination-below-threshold.yaml
Title: "Small loan (€50k) approved at L2 without committee"
A loan application for €50,000 is submitted.
L1 credit officer assesses and approves.
L2 credit director reviews and approves.
Since amount ≤€500k, no committee is needed — loan is disbursed directly.
via: api steps.

SCENARIO 3 — meridian-regulatory-compliance-review-bafin.yaml
Title: "30-day SLA breach triggers BaFin regulatory notice"
An ongoing compliance review exceeds the 30-day SLA.
The system detects the SLA breach.
BaFin regulatory notification is automatically filed.
Escalation is triggered to senior management (Eva Kremer).
via: api steps.

MANDATORY BUSINESS RULES from BO-MERIDIAN agent instructions:
- Loan >€500k MUST trigger committee vote (quorum 2-of-3).
- 30-day SLA breach MUST file BaFin regulatory notice.
- KYC hit without manual compliance review is BLOCKER.
- Committee quorum of <2 is BLOCKER.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario YAML files created at tests/simulation/scenarios/meridian-loan-origination-above-threshold.yaml.yaml and meridian-loan-origination-below-threshold.yaml.yaml (or meridian-regulatory-compliance-review-bafin.yaml.yaml if three)
Each scenario follows the schema from docs/agents/uat-scenario-schema.md
Mandatory business rules from BO agent instructions are tested
Via field contains realistic API instructions for each step
Cleanup section removes any test artifacts

result.summary: Authored 3 Meridian UAT scenarios: large-loan (above-threshold), small-loan (below-threshold), compliance-bafin
result.next_action: Route to UAT-RUNNER for schema validation (WF-06 Step 1b)
